about: The only hard-coded explanation template for AquaBlend (backlog Task 38). Placeholders in {braces} are filled by fill_template.py from the MILP output (only fields the Task 45 agreement allows) and the scenario input. Change wording here, not in the script.

solver_status_labels.infeasible: infeasible: no blend meets every constraint

VALID.title: {scenario_name}: blending result
VALID.headline_optimal: The optimal blend for {scenario_name} delivers {total_delivered} ML/day against a demand of {total_demand} ML/day, at a total cost of {total_cost}.
VALID.headline_not_optimal: A feasible blend (not proven optimal) for {scenario_name} delivers {total_delivered} ML/day against a demand of {total_demand} ML/day, at a total cost of {total_cost}.

sources.heading: Sources ({selected_count} of {source_count} used)
sources.SELECTED: {name} ({source_id}): {withdrawal} ML/day, {blend_percent}% of the blend, {utilisation}% of its maximum withdrawal

zones.heading: Demand zones
zones.short: {name}: {delivered} of {demand} ML/day delivered, a shortfall of {unmet} ML/day
zones.short_no_demand: {name}: {delivered} ML/day delivered, a shortfall of {unmet} ML/day

costs.heading: Costs
costs.text: Total cost {total_cost}: source fixed {source_fixed}, source variable {source_variable}, plant fixed {plant_fixed}, plant variable {plant_variable}.

caveats: Costs are in the model's cost units. No currency is set in the model output.
Water-quality figures describe the blended water entering the plant, before any treatment.
VALID.caveat_dosing_off: Chemical dosing is turned off in this scenario, so no dosing or chemical costs are included.

NO_SOLUTION.title: {scenario_name}: no valid solution
NO_SOLUTION.headline: No valid solution was found for {scenario_name}.
NO_SOLUTION.text: The solver result was {solver_status_label}. The scenario asks for {total_demand} ML/day across {zone_count} demand zone(s), from {source_count} source(s).
NO_SOLUTION.no_figures: No costs, flows or water-quality figures are shown, because without a valid solution they do not describe a real plan.
caveats: The model output does not say which constraint made the scenario impossible to solve.

INVALID_OUTPUT.title: {scenario_name}: result not usable
INVALID_OUTPUT.headline: The result for {scenario_name} failed its internal checks and should not be used.
INVALID_OUTPUT.text: The solver result was {solver_status_label}, but the output did not pass the MILP pipeline's consistency checks, so no figures are shown.
caveats: Ask the Optimisation team to look at this run before using it.
